game.title: Miami Dolphins at Las Vegas Raiders

lede: Miami Dolphins carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#22 in EPA per play), while Las Vegas Raiders owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#13 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Las Vegas Raiders +1.2 with a fair total of 42.3 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Las Vegas Raiders run offence vs Miami Dolphins run defence, which sits −0.175 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
